title: Oven-Smoked Ukrainian Trout Chowder
description: Rich smoky chowder with flaky trout, caramelized onions, and a hint of candied ginger for subtle sweetness, served hot.

ingredients.name: Seasonings
ingredients.notes: salt and pepper, use only salt if desired

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place trout fillets on the sheet, drizzle with 1 tsp liquid smoke and 1 tsp olive oil, and bake for 12-15 minutes until just cooked.
While trout cooks, heat butter in a large pot over medium heat and sauté pearl onions until translucent.
Add diced carrots to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes.
Pour in the low-sodium stock and bring to a gentle boil; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Flake the baked trout into large chunks and add to the pot along with grated candied ginger and chopped dill.
Stir in the heavy cream, lemon juice, and season with pepper; simmer for 5 more minutes until flavors meld.
Serve hot, garnished with extra dill and a drizzle of olive oil.
